series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. DS-40: Total GHG emissions including LULUCF/LUCF exactly as the Party submitted them to the UNFCCC, on that Party’s own reporting guidelines and GWP set (UNFCCC Data Interface, snapshot of 2024-07-05). Non-Annex I Parties report only the years their national communications cover, and the figure is negative where reported removals exceed reported emissions. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

derived.$note: Trend: least-squares slope over 35 observed years (1990-2024) from DS-35, compared against the DS-06-NDC target of 4.9 MtCO₂e by 2030. The two are not necessarily on the same inventory scope, see series.$note. The target tonnage is derived here, not quoted: 30% below the document's own business-as-usual projection of 7 MtCO₂e for 2030. The document states the percentage and the projection; the engine did the arithmetic.
derived.$reason: observed emissions are rising by 0.10 MtCO₂e/yr while the target requires a fall of 0.09 MtCO₂e/yr. No multiple of the current trend reaches it, so no finite gap factor is reported.

country_profile.$note: Population is World Bank SP.POP.TOTL for the latest year published in the 2015-2025 window. Income group is the World Bank's own classification, not a UNFCCC one.

emissions_profile.$note: Headline totals are OWID only. OWID's CO₂ sub-totals are fossil/industrial CO₂ by fuel, not a full sectoral GHG breakdown, and do not sum to total_mtco2e. DS-05's rows are non-CO₂ gases only and are not comparable with the others; that is also why DS-05 is absent from series.observed, where a shorter curve would read as a disagreement rather than a difference of scope. by_source carries each source whole.

verdict.text: Mauritius pledges a 30% reduction by 2030 against 2030 business-as-usual. A later submission, NDC 3.0, was filed on 2025-09-29; it has not been read, so no figure here comes from it. 55 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (9). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 9.3 MtCO₂e, DS-35 5.4 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. The target is not reached on the observed trend. It submitted BTR1. 5 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 51.2 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 30% reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to the BAU scenario (7 MtCO2e) It was classed conditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +0.75°C under SSP1-2.6 to +2.96°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
